ASBESTOS MOTION CALENDAR ON JAN-04-2007 IN 206, PLAINTIFF'S MOTION FOR ORDER GRANTING PREFERENCE IN SETTING CASE FOR TRIAL WAS GRANTED PURSUANT TO CCP 36(D). THE TRIAL DATE IS SET FOR 4/9/07 @ 11:15AM IN DEPT. 206; SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE SET FOR 3/7/07 @ 1:30PM IN DEPT. 501. THE STATUS AND SETTING CONFERENCE OF 6/21/07 IS VACATED. IF DEFENDANTS LEARNS OF NEW WITNESSES, IN GOOD FAITH, THEY SHALL IMMEDIATELY BE DISCLOSED ALONG WITH DECLARATION AS TO WHY THIS DISCLOSURE WAS NOT PROVIDED ON THE DUE DATE. ALL ECONOMIC EXPERT DISCOVERY IS TO BE COMPLETED 14 CALENDAR DAYS BEFORE THE TRIAL DATE, INCLUDING DEPOSITION OF ECONOMIC EXPERT. THE PARED-DOWN LIST OF EXPERTS WILL BE FAXED NO LATER THAN 14 DAYS BEFORE TRIAL DATE. NO LATER THAN 12 DAYS BEFORE THE TRIAL DATE, EACH SIDE MAY IDENTIFY UP TO THREE EXPERT WITNESSES PERCEIVED TO BE NECESSARY TO BE DEPOSED FOR MEANINGFUL SETTLEMENT DISCUSSIONS TO OCCUR. THESE EXPERTS WILL BE DEPOSED PRIOR TO THE TRIAL DATE. TRIAL WILL NOT BE DELAYED FOR THE PURPOSE OF DEPOSING EXPERTS. PLAINTIFF AND BERRY & BERRY ARE TO MEET AND CONFER REGARDING CONCLUSION OF PLAINTIFF'S SPOUSE'S DEPOSITION. WRITTEN ORDER PENDING.
